summary: Moved the theme control from the bottom-right text pill to a fixed round button at the top right, in the margin beside the contact button. Light mode shows a sun icon and dark mode shows a moon. Both states were clicked in the browser and stay clear of the contact label on the desktop layout.
current_status: Portfolio has Swarm canvas, Lovable draft copy, scroll animation, and persisted light/dark mode with a stable top-right sun/moon toggle. No personal email or profile URLs were invented. Nothing new is committed.
